text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer.
Um, listen to this~.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I talked on the phone
with my father last night, and—

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hello? Dad?
Where are you now? Australia?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, you worry too much.
I told you, I'm doing just fine.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, listen to this!
I can bench press even heavier weights
than before!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: Now that I've built up power, I can dig in strong on any kind of track surface!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah, that's right. I did work hard, but really,
it's all thanks to you, Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Your advice is so accurate and easy to understand.
It really shows how closely you've been watching me~

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...Hm?
"I'm glad you got to meet someone like that"?

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
And I have a message from her father:
'Please take good care of my daughter.'
choice_data_list: Likewise. I'll keep doing my best.

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'll do my best too!
I look forward to continuing to work with you,
Trainer!
